doc: Multiple micronutrient powders for point-of-use fortification of foods consumed by children 2–12 years of age

entries.claim: 在学龄儿童贫血患病率≥20%的人群中，推荐2-12岁儿童使用含铁微量营养素粉剂进行食品点用强化，以改善铁状况和减少贫血。
entries.source_doc: Multiple micronutrient powders for point-of-use fortification of foods consumed by children 2–12 years of age
